subject.title: MissingAgentHarnessError race: non-atomic harness registry clear+restore during plugin cache cycle

question: When a plugin reload resolves to an empty plugin scope, which agent harnesses, if any, should remain selectable by gateway dispatch?
rationale: The source bug is real, but preserving every prior harness can keep disabled or unscoped plugin-owned code reachable; automation cannot choose that lifecycle/security boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Preserve Only Approved Always-On Harnesses
options.body: Define and test a narrow contract that keeps maintainer-approved built-in or always-on runtime harnesses while clearing disabled or unscoped plugin-owned harnesses.

options.title: Accept Restore-All Semantics
options.body: Allow all previously registered harnesses to survive empty-scope reloads, documenting that empty active plugin registries do not necessarily make prior harnesses unreachable.

options.title: Clear All And Gate Dispatch
options.body: Keep empty-scope reloads fail-closed and add readiness/dispatch gating so channel and cron work waits instead of racing a missing harness.

recommendation.title: Preserve Only Approved Always-On Harnesses
recommendation.body: Define and test a narrow contract that keeps maintainer-approved built-in or always-on runtime harnesses while clearing disabled or unscoped plugin-owned harnesses.

likelyOwner.reason: The harness registry was introduced in this history path and current blame ties the present registry and loader/gateway lifecycle code to this owner trail.
